fronius_gen24_byd_hvs.json.source: Entity registry and states of a Fronius GEN24 inverter with BYD Battery-Box Premium HVS via the core integration fronius (SolarAPI and Modbus TCP), Home Assistant 2026.10.4, read on 2026-10-30. Keys checked against homeassistant/components/fronius/sensor.py at tag 2026.10.4 and dev (unique id stays '<inverter>-modbus-<key>').
fronius_gen24_byd_hvs.json.real: unique id formats (inverter '<id>-modbus-<key>', battery '<serial padded with spaces>-<key>', power flow 'solar_net_<id>-power_flow-<key>'), keys, units (Wh), device and state classes (capacity without state class), the MPPT 3/4 energy sensors that repeat the battery counters, the sign of the battery power (negative while charging).
fronius_gen24_byd_hvs.json.made_up: inverter id, battery serial number, entity ids (without the owner's area prefix) and every state value.

huawei_solar_luna2000.json.source: Derived from the source code of wlcrs/huawei_solar 2.1.5 at commit 9738e50280ac5422fdb490d9ed9319071e9a54bf and wlcrs/huawei-solar-lib v3.0.7 at commit d7254ca4e75960c2013afb3bd345ef64b7d1985c on 2026-10-30 (sensor.py, number.py, __init__.py, const.py, types.py, strings.json; registers.py, register_values.py, register_definitions/number.py); not read from a real installation.
huawei_solar_luna2000.json.real: platform huawei_solar; unique_id scheme <inverter serial>_<register key>; device identifiers <SN>/connected_energy_storage, <SN>/battery_1, <SN>/battery_2; entity_ids and friendly_names for an English HA install; units, device_class, state_class (aggregate totals 'total' without last_reset, per-unit/pack totals 'total_increasing'), icons, entity_category, disabled-by-default flags; status strings like 'Running'/'Sleep mode'; float formatting from gain 10/100.
huawei_solar_luna2000.json.made_up: inverter serial HV2299990001, inverter model, every state value (energies, SoC, power, temperatures, voltages, status/working-mode choice, rated capacity, backup SoC); the combination of 2 storage units with 3 packs on unit 1.

solarman_deye_hybrid.json.source: Derived from the source code of solarman (davidrapan/ha-solarman) at commit ac1d88b83268beeb0511b8a1b7fc8e17deddc044 (main, 2026-05-03, 3 commits after pre-release v26.01.31) on 2026-10-30 (entity.py, sensor.py, number.py, common.py, coordinator.py, parser.py, __init__.py, const.py, translations/en.json, inverter_definitions/deye_hybrid.yaml); not read from a real installation.
solarman_deye_hybrid.json.real: unique id format '<config entry id, lowercased>_<slugified English profile name>_<platform>' (platform solarman), entity id pattern '<platform>.<device name>_<profile name>' with the default device name 'Inverter', original names, units, device and state classes, icons, the attribute names ('Nominal Voltage'/'Life Cycle Rating' from the default options 48 V / 6000, 'BMS …' attributes, '−x' on Battery Power, 'description', 'options', 'states'), English friendly names incl. the translated "Today's …", that nothing here is disabled by default, the sign convention (Battery Power negative = charging, Battery State from ±50 W), and that the profile has no SOH or cycle entities.
solarman_deye_hybrid.json.made_up: the config entry id, the inverter serial number and every state and attribute value (meter readings, SOC, power, current, voltage, temperature, capacity estimate and its 'states' list, the 280 Ah setting, BMS values). The Battery Current sign is not verified.

solarman_deye_p3.json.source: Derived from the source code of solarman (davidrapan/ha-solarman) at commit ac1d88b83268beeb0511b8a1b7fc8e17deddc044 (main, 2026-05-03) on 2026-10-30 (entity.py, sensor.py, number.py, common.py, coordinator.py, __init__.py, const.py, translations/en.json, inverter_definitions/deye_p3.yaml); not read from a real installation.
solarman_deye_p3.json.real: unique id and entity id format as for deye_hybrid, the computed entities 'Battery SOH' and 'Today/Total Battery Life Cycles' (no device class, Life Cycles without unit), the per-pack entities 'Battery 1 …' (only when the pack count register 0x2712 reports ≥ 1) on their own device linked via via_device with the pack serial number as identifier and the parent's name, 'Alt Name' and 'Corrected Capacity' attributes, units and state classes.
solarman_deye_p3.json.made_up: the config entry id, the inverter and pack serial numbers and every state and attribute value. The SOH and life-cycle values are computed consistently with the made-up numbers using the integration's formula (280 Ah × 48 V, rating 6000).

anker_solix_solarbank.json.source: Derived from the source code of ha-anker-solix (thomluther/ha-anker-solix) 3.9.1 at commit d5102551b5dbc037c60a6a07663f8b148bd58ff7 on 2026-10-30 (sensor.py, number.py, entity.py, api_client.py, const.py, translations/de.json, solixapi/api.py, solixapi/apibase.py, solixapi/apitypes.py, solixapi/mqttmap.py); not read from a real installation. Assumed setup: Solarbank 3 E2700 Pro (A17C5) with one expansion battery, owner account, MQTT on (default), MQTT overlay off, category 'solarbank_energy' removed from the exclusions (it is excluded by default; without that the energy, efficiency and daily entities do not exist), HA language German.
anker_solix_solarbank.json.real: unique id format '<device serial lower case>_<key>' for device entities and '<site_id>_<key>' for system entities (platform anker_solix), keys, units, device and state classes (efficiency sensors have none), enum options, attribute names (state_of_health, serialnumber, capacity, charging_status, status, date, last_period, calculated, expansions, attribution), German entity names and the entity ids HA derives from them, device structure (system device with site_id, solarbank device with serial; expansions are no devices of their own), sign of battery power (positive = charging), efficiency formula.
anker_solix_solarbank.json.made_up: serial numbers, site id, site name, every state value; battery_status value 'discharging' (the source maps SB3 raw 2 to discharging, but a code comment says 2 = charging for SB3).

anker_solix_solarbank2_default.json.source: Derived from the source code of ha-anker-solix (thomluther/ha-anker-solix) 3.9.1 at commit d5102551b5dbc037c60a6a07663f8b148bd58ff7 on 2026-10-30 (same files as anker_solix_solarbank.json); not read from a real installation. Assumed setup: Solarbank 2 E1600 Pro (A17C1) with one expansion battery, owner account, MQTT on, default exclusions (all energy categories excluded), no real-time trigger active at setup.
anker_solix_solarbank2_default.json.real: which battery entities exist with default options (no lifetime counters, no efficiency, no daily energies), unique id format, keys, units, device and state classes, German entity names and derived entity ids, sign of battery power (positive = charging); SB2 has no SoH in MQTT, so no state_of_health attribute.
anker_solix_solarbank2_default.json.made_up: serial number, site id, every state value.

anker_solix_official_sb4.json.source: Derived from the source code of ha-anker-solix-official (anker-charging/ha-anker-solix-official) v1.5.0 at commit 3ecc42b9cb30beef24377f47486cb1eee985e1e3 on 2026-10-30 (base_entity.py, sensor.py, coordinator.py, const.py, config/58f0132b5f7979b2cfa43a0eb1fca770053288032386ff6a4da5ed2d72d4ea35.yaml, translations/de.json); not read from a real installation. Solarbank 4 E5000 Pro over local Modbus TCP, HA language German.
anker_solix_official_sb4.json.real: unique id format '<config entry id>_<key>' (platform anker_solix_official), keys, units, device and state classes (derived from the unit: kWh -> energy/total_increasing, also for rated_energy), Modbus addresses and data types in the attributes, enum options, German entity names and derived entity ids, 0.1 kWh resolution of the counters.
anker_solix_official_sb4.json.made_up: config entry id and every state value.

solaredge_modbus_multi_storedge.json.source: Derived from the source code of WillCodeForCats/solaredge-modbus-multi v4.0.10 at commit 70aa15946579778543e56d73139e6ab2a59216c8 (2026-10-29) on 2026-10-30 (sensor.py, hub.py, components.py, const.py, strings.json; wiki Known-Issues.md and Configuration.md at ef8ae9f7a804690ba00583f63503d112867dcb93); not read from a real installation. Assumed setup: hub name 'SolarEdge' (default), option 'Auto-Detect Batteries' switched on (default off), one inverter (device id 1) with two batteries B1 and B2, HA 2026.10 (English).
solaredge_modbus_multi_storedge.json.real: platform solaredge_modbus_multi; unique id scheme '<inverter C_Model>_<inverter C_SerialNumber>_B<1-3>_<key>' for battery entities and '<model>_<serial>_<key>' for inverter entities (DER storage SoC '<model>_<serial>_storage_<n>_soc'); keys, names, device names 'Solaredge I1 B1' and the entity ids HA derives from them; units (counters and energies native Wh with suggested kWh, so the registry unit is kWh), device classes (energy, energy_storage, battery, enum), state classes (counters total_increasing, SoH without device class), entity categories, disabled-by-default flags (Max Temperature always, DC Power Inverted on HA >= 2026.2), status option strings, the attributes of the Device sensor, the sign of DC Power (positive = charging).
solaredge_modbus_multi_storedge.json.made_up: inverter model string and serial number, battery model and serial numbers, rated energy, every state value (counters, SoE, SoH, energies, power, voltage, current, temperatures, status), the DER storage SoC value and the combination of two batteries on one inverter.

solax_modbus_x3_hybrid_g4.json.source: Derived from the source code of wills106/homeassistant-solax-modbus 2026.10.02 at commit b6880b69d811d38581223322d8dd65f193b47bfb (2026-10-28) on 2026-10-30 (sensor.py, __init__.py, const.py, plugin_solax.py, docs/solax-entity-description.md); not read from a real installation. Assumed setup: plugin_solax, SolaX X3-Hybrid G4 (HYBRID | GEN4), hub name 'SolaX' (default), Modbus protocol version >= 1.00 (needed for battery_system_installed_capacity), Energy Dashboard device off, battery pack reading not applicable (plugin_solax has no BATTERY_CONFIG), HA language English.
solax_modbus_x3_hybrid_g4.json.real: platform solax_modbus; unique id scheme '<hub name>_<key>' (the hub name from the config entry, default 'SolaX'); keys, names, entity ids and friendly names (device name = hub name); units, device classes, state classes (lifetime counters 'total' without last_reset, daily counters 'total_increasing', capacity sensors without state class), icons, the attribute 'ed_mapping_present', disabled-by-default flags (both lifetime counters, Battery Total Energy, Installed Capacity, Chargeable/Remaining Energy and SoH are disabled by default; SoC 'Battery Capacity' and the daily counters are enabled), 0.1 kWh resolution of the counters, sign of Battery Power Charge (negative = discharging).
solax_modbus_x3_hybrid_g4.json.made_up: the config entry id and every state value; in a default installation the disabled entities have no state (the fixture shows them as if the user had enabled them).

goodwe_et.json.source: Derived from the source code of the core integration goodwe at home-assistant/core tag 2026.10.4 (commit 357cae5c598dfcd7a0ea7dc5b1facccd4ec6037b; sensor.py, coordinator.py, __init__.py, config_flow.py, const.py, number.py, strings.json) and the library goodwe (marcelblijleven/goodwe) v0.4.10 at commit 66dfcdd9cd947bfd799f2bddb40b4e05ba9db6f6 (et.py, es.py, sensor.py, model.py, const.py, __init__.py) on 2026-10-30; not read from a real installation. The HACS variant mletenay/home-assistant-goodwe-inverter v0.9.9.31 uses the same domain, library version and unique id format. Assumed setup: GW10K-ET (ET family) with one battery, HA language English.
goodwe_et.json.real: platform goodwe; unique id format 'goodwe-<sensor id>-<inverter serial>' for sensors and numbers; sensor ids (e_bat_charge_total, e_bat_discharge_total, e_bat_charge_day, e_bat_discharge_day, battery_soc, battery_soh, pbattery1, vbattery1, ibattery1, battery_mode_label, battery_temperature, e_total, battery_discharge_depth); device name 'GoodWe' (entry title) and English friendly names from the library's sensor names; units, device and state classes (every kWh sensor total_increasing, including the day counters; battery_soc gets device class battery); icons by sensor kind; entity_category diagnostic for everything outside _MAIN_SENSORS; nothing disabled by default; 0.1 kWh resolution of the counters; battery mode labels; battery power positive while discharging (from the house consumption formula).
goodwe_et.json.made_up: inverter serial 9010KETU229W9999, model, every state value; the entity ids are derived from the names, not observed.

victron_gx_smartshunt.json.source: Derived from the source code of the core integration victron_gx at home-assistant/core tag 2026.10.4 (commit 357cae5c598dfcd7a0ea7dc5b1facccd4ec6037b; entity.py, sensor.py, hub.py, config_flow.py, strings.json, manifest.json) and the library victron-mqtt (tomer-w/victron_mqtt) v2026.9.5 at commit 37fbc4db19caf59efbdeddf8aa2e0fce7387a13c (_victron_topics.py, data_classes.py, device.py, _victron_enums.py, _victron_formulas.py) on 2026-10-30, paths checked against victronenergy/venus wiki dbus.md at 6c2e5287d41e3814f3b37c6d3a47061f18d48109; not read from a real installation. Assumed setup: GX device with a SmartShunt on VE.Direct (device instance 279) and a CAN-bus BMS battery (instance 512), HA language English, no custom device names.
victron_gx_smartshunt.json.real: platform victron_gx; unique id format '<VRM portal id>_<device type>_<device instance>_<metric short id>' (battery metrics 'battery_<instance>_battery_<key>', system metrics 'system_0_system_<key>'); device identifier '<portal id>_battery_<instance>'; device name rule '<model> (ID: <instance>)' without custom name, 'Victron Venus' for the system device without model; metric keys, names ('Charge', 'Charged energy', 'Discharged energy', 'Capacity', 'Installed capacity', 'DC battery charge energy'), units (kWh, %, Ah, W, V, A, 'cycles'), device and state classes (energy total_increasing; Ah sensors without device class, measurement; Cumulative Ah drawn total); nothing here disabled by default; battery power positive while charging (Venus dbus convention); the system charge/discharge energies are library-side Riemann sums that start at 0 on every Home Assistant start.
victron_gx_smartshunt.json.made_up: portal id c0619ab9f0e1, config entry id, device instances, models, every state value; which paths the CAN-bus BMS publishes (assumed: SoC, installed capacity, power, no History energies); the entity ids are derived from the names, not observed.
